hooks.name: youdede-outbound-data-guard
hooks.description: [youdede:outbound-data-guard] Block explicit local-file uploads and dynamic payloads sent by common network commands.

limitations: This first native tranche covers shell-command interception only; write, MCP, prompt, and lifecycle boundaries remain withheld pending fixtures.

Google stopped serving Gemini CLI on 2026-06-18 for free use and Google AI Pro and Ultra; it remains available with Gemini Code Assist Standard or Enterprise licenses and paid API keys. Antigravity CLI is not a target of this adapter.
